limitations: All variants load their source-owned same-origin fixture stylesheet and satisfy every fixed computed-shadow check under the unchanged original CSP.

Ten observations fail the source-declared early-load condition; the dynamic stylesheet load callback does not precede every required document/frame milestone. They remain incomplete and cannot qualify a cold-start comparison.

A first animation-frame callback can precede application content readiness; these callback clocks are not actual paint timestamps. The next fixture uses parser-created stylesheet ordering and an explicit pre-application marker rather than retroactively relabeling these results.
All original eight resource timing projections and owned cleanup are valid, but do not replace the missing early fixture coverage.

Raw logs, CSP messages, screenshots, traces and private controller artifacts were not read. Normal acceptance passes all ten jobs with26verifiedZIPs and matching actual controller binaries; it does not repair the missing early stylesheet coverage.
